site.name: MKR Caucasian Camp
site.description: MMA and Wrestling training camps in the Caucasus. Adult and youth wrestling in Dagestan, MMA in Chechnya. One discipline per camp. 1 to 3 week immersion with local coaching.

organization.description: MMA and Wrestling training camps in the Caucasus, run by Ruslan Mukhtarov, former French Wrestling Team athlete (INSEP).
organization.founder_description: Ruslan Mukhtarov, 32, former French Wrestling Team athlete, trained at INSEP (2012-2016).

person_ruslan.job_title: Founder and wrestling and MMA coach
person_ruslan.alumni_of_name: INSEP, the French National Institute of Sport, Expertise and Performance

events.session_description_template: Training camp of 1 to 3 weeks in the Caucasus. 15 Wrestling spots in Dagestan plus 15 MMA spots in Chechnya (exclusive). Domestic flight from Istanbul, Russian visa, accommodation and 2 meals per day included.

dagestan.name: Wrestling training facilities in Dagestan
dagestan.description: Official wrestling halls in Makhachkala and Kaspiysk, partners of the Russian Wrestling Federation.
dagestan.amenity_flight: Istanbul to Makhachkala domestic flight included

tchetchenie.name: MMA training facilities in Chechnya
tchetchenie.description: MMA gyms in Grozny, in the lineage of Akhmat Fight Club.
